review_evidence: README explicitly presents a Lean formalization of the Prince Rupert polyhedron problem and lists main results for the cube, tetrahedron, triakis tetrahedron, and a non-Rupert example.
Ten of 20 Lean files contain 57 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.
Representative results include square_is_rupert, rotation/SO3 lemmas, quaternion-to-matrix facts and the named polyhedron theorems.
summary: Reviewed Rupert.lean; retain the geometric formalization of the Rupert problem and its proved polyhedron results.
